name: soils
title: Soils: the NRCS soil survey, the soil card and the ground's soil types

sources.name: ssurgo
sources.credit: Soils: USDA NRCS, Soil Survey Geographic Database (SSURGO)

commands.name: soils-load
commands.help: load the soil survey prepared by plugins/soils/build/prepare.py (--from DIR)

storage: About 110 MB in PostGIS (measured Oct 11), almost all of it the 21,999 polygons (2.66 M vertices, whole, plus a 5 m simplified copy and indexes); a few thousand map units, components and horizons (about 4 MB); under 5,000 photo-statistics rows per photo build, old builds kept. Each prepared folder ($TVT_ARCHIVE/soils/prepared/<stamp>/) is about 75 MB. Reloaded once a year at most.
ethics: USDA NRCS's soil survey: public domain, credited "Soils: USDA NRCS, Soil Survey Geographic Database (SSURGO)". Not for regulatory decisions, as NRCS says, and the card says so. Downloaded by hand with the owner's OK for each yearly refresh; no collector and no schedule. Soils, not people.
